name: tracklution-cli-workspace
description: Workspace root for the tracklution-cli monorepo. Publishes: tracklution, create-tracklution, @tracklution/cli, tracklution-mcp.

scripts.lint: node --check packages/tracklution/bin/cli.js && node --check packages/tracklution/src/payload.js && node --check packages/create-tracklution/bin/cli.js && node --check packages/at-tracklution-cli/bin/cli.js && node --check packages/tracklution-mcp/bin/cli.js
scripts.pack:dry: npm pack --workspace tracklution --dry-run && npm pack --workspace create-tracklution --dry-run && npm pack --workspace @tracklution/cli --dry-run && npm pack --workspace tracklution-mcp --dry-run
